g.title: Receive phase: Synthetic phase goal: the customer sends the unwanted item back with minimal effort.
Inspect phase: Synthetic phase goal: the returned item is checked and triaged quickly.
Decide phase: Synthetic phase goal: a fair refund-or-replace decision is made transparently.
Refund phase: Synthetic phase goal: money or a replacement reaches the customer without chasing.
Action / receive: Synthetic: customer prints the prepaid label and drops the parcel at a corner shop.
Action / inspect: Synthetic: customer waits while the warehouse scans and grades the returned item.
Action / decide: Synthetic: customer reads the decision email and accepts the proposed refund.
Action / refund: Synthetic: customer sees the refund land on the original card and archives the receipt.
Touchpoint / receive: Synthetic: returns portal with order lookup and a QR code for the drop-off point.

g.title: Touchpoint / inspect: Synthetic: tracking page shows the parcel arrived and inspection has started.
Touchpoint / decide: Synthetic: decision email explains the outcome with photos from the inspection.
Touchpoint / refund: Synthetic: bank statement line and a closing confirmation message in the portal.
Opportunity / receive: Synthetic opportunity: prefill the returns form from the order history to cut retyping.
Opportunity / inspect: Synthetic opportunity: publish typical inspection times so waiting feels predictable.
Opportunity / decide: Synthetic opportunity: offer a one-click appeal path when a refund is declined.
Opportunity / refund: Synthetic opportunity: instant refund to wallet instead of a five-day card settlement.
